text: A reservoir is a big lake that people made to store water. Williston Lake is a very large one.
Unstable means not steady. It can wobble, move, or fall apart, so it may not be safe to stand on.
To suggest is to share an idea that might be right. Mr. Gammer shared an idea about how the island began.
Curious here means strange and puzzling, so you want to know more.
A mystery is something strange that nobody can explain yet.
An island is land with water all around it.
British Columbia is a province in western Canada.
Canada is a big country just north of the United States.
A province is a part of a country, a little like a state.
Williston Lake is a huge lake in British Columbia, Canada.
Man-made means built or made by people, not by nature.
Square miles measure how much flat space something covers. This lake covers a very big area.
A kilometer is a way to measure distance. It is a little more than half a mile.
BC Hydro is a company that makes electricity in British Columbia. It looks after the reservoir.
Government-run means the people who lead a place are in charge of it.
T-shaped means it looks like the letter T.
Boaters are people who ride in boats.
Social media is where people share pictures and videos on phones and computers.
Bob Gammer is a man who works for BC Hydro.
AI means artificial intelligence. It is a computer that can make pictures that look real but are not.
A satellite is an object that goes around the Earth, high up in space. Many take pictures of the ground.
A satellite image is a picture of the Earth taken from space.
Sure enough means just as he guessed.
A yard is a way to measure length. It is about three feet.
A meter is a way to measure length. It is a little more than a yard.
A football field is very long. Two of them end to end make a huge space.
Floating means sitting on top of water and not sinking.
Logs are thick pieces of tree trunk.
Built up means gathered into a bigger and bigger pile over time.
A protected area is a spot where the wind and waves cannot reach very well. It is calm.
The coast is the land right next to the water.
Seeds are tiny parts of plants. A new plant can grow from each one.
A mass is a big lump of things stuck together.
Roots are the parts of a plant under the ground. They hold the plant in place.
Tie together means to hold many pieces so they stay as one.
The water level is how high the water comes up.
The shoreline is the edge where land meets water.
Broken loose means freed from what was holding it. The high water set the island free.
Searching means looking carefully for something that is lost.
Pushed up against means pressed right next to something.
A sail is a big piece of cloth on a boat. The wind pushes it and the boat moves.
Famous means many people know about it.
Warned means told to be careful because of danger.
